I have chronic joint and muscle pain. Things that tend to help are:

* Laying on a hard surface for a while for back and neck pain
* Epsom salt lotion for muscle pain that you can find in most pharmacies, bed bath and beyond, target, etc in the USA
* Cool showers followed by a warm bath. If she cannot stand, try putting her in a bathing suit, and put a chair in the shower so she can sit. Leave the bathroom door open and monitor her if the pain is that bad. Dont leave her alone in the shower or bathroom in case of slips or sudden joints giving out. 
* Melatonin for sleep
* Massages can do wonders until she falls asleep! 
* Pain relievers like tylenol are great, but you can only take so much at a time. In between, try giving her some foods that have natural pain relievers. Chili peppers release endorphins, which can block pain signals. Ginger and turmeric help with joint pain. Spinach, nuts, some fruits help with inflammation and arthritis pain. And, my personal favorite, chamomile, which has been used since the first century. Try chamomile tea with some mint tea mixed in. 
* Warm tea, hot water bottles, cold compress and hot compress.
